=== FILE: gray_counter_equiv.eqy ===
[gold]
read_verilog gray_counter.v
prep -top gray_counter

[gate]
read_verilog gray_counter_refactor.v
prep -top gray_counter

[strategy sby]
use sby
depth 20
engine smtbmc yices
=== END FILE ===

result.detail:
There is exactly one equivalence_setup file, and it does not reuse either source file name. Only allow-listed commands (read_verilog, prep) and allowed sections ([gold], [gate], [strategy]) are used.

One risk: if the gate's smtbmc solver word list excludes yices, the setup will be refused. In that case, change the engine line to another allowed smtbmc solver and resubmit.

The tool_run evidence requirement can only be met by the platform's equivalence.run over this setup.
